start.title: At the Gate of Sodom
start.text:
It is evening. You are sitting in the gateway of the city of Sodom.
Two angels arrive at Sodom. What do you do?

choices.text: Get up to meet them and bow down with your face to the ground
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:1 — When Lot saw them, he got up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the ground.

choices.text: Turn away and ignore the strangers
choices.feedback: Genesis says Lot rose and bowed before them.

choices.text: Chase them out of the city with a staff
choices.feedback: Genesis says Lot welcomed them respectfully.

wickedness.title: Come to My House
wickedness.text:
You speak to the two strangers.
What do you say?

choices.text: 'My lords, please turn aside to your servant's house; you can wash your feet and spend the night'
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:2 — 'My lords, please turn aside to your servant's house. You can wash your feet and spend the night and then go on your way early in the morning.'

choices.text: 'Leave Sodom at once — it is not safe here'
choices.feedback: Lot urged them to spend the night at his house.

choices.text: 'Sleep here in the square as you planned'
choices.feedback: Lot insisted the angels come home with him rather than stay in the square.

strangers.title: A Meal in Your House
strangers.text:
The angels come home with you.
What do you prepare for them?

choices.text: Prepare a meal for them, baking bread without yeast
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:3 — He prepared a meal for them, baking bread without yeast, and they ate.

choices.text: Offer them only water and send them to bed
choices.feedback: Lot baked bread and prepared a meal for them.

choices.text: Offer them a lamb roasted with fire
choices.feedback: Genesis specifies unleavened bread, not roasted lamb.

welcome.title: The Men of the City
welcome.text:
Before you go to bed, all the men of Sodom — young and old — surround the house.
What do they demand?

choices.text: 'Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us'
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:5 — They called to Lot, 'Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us so that we can have sex with them.'

choices.text: 'Give us food and gold from your house'
choices.feedback: The men demanded Lot's guests, not gold.

choices.text: 'Welcome us to eat with the strangers'
choices.feedback: The men of Sodom came with hostile intent, not a friendly request.

mob.title: At the Door
mob.text:
You go outside to speak to the crowd.
What do you do with the door?

choices.text: Go out to them and shut the door behind you
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:6 — Lot went outside to meet them and shut the door behind him.

choices.text: Leave the door wide open so the guests can flee
choices.feedback: Lot shut the door behind him to protect the guests.

choices.text: Hand the guests over to the crowd yourself
choices.feedback: Lot pleaded with the men not to harm his guests.

angels_warn.title: Pulled Inside
angels_warn.text:
The crowd surges to break down the door.
What do the angels do?

choices.text: The angels reach out, pull you back into the house, and strike the men with blindness
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:10-11 — The men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door. Then they struck the men at the door with blindness.

choices.text: The angels open the door and let the crowd inside
choices.feedback: The angels pulled Lot in and struck the crowd with blindness.

choices.text: The angels vanish silently and abandon you
choices.feedback: The angels rescued Lot and stayed with him.

sons_in_law.title: Warn Your Family
sons_in_law.text:
The angels tell you to warn your relatives about the coming destruction.
How do your sons-in-law respond?

choices.text: Your sons-in-law think you are joking
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:14 — Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, but they thought he was joking.

choices.text: Your sons-in-law believe you and follow at once
choices.feedback: The sons-in-law did not take Lot seriously.

choices.text: Your sons-in-law kill you for the warning
choices.feedback: Genesis says they thought Lot was joking.

urge.title: Dawn — Flee for Your Lives
urge.text:
As dawn breaks, the angels urge you to hurry.
What do they say?

choices.text: 'Flee for your lives! Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains'
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:17 — 'Flee for your lives! Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!'

choices.text: 'Take your gold and hide inside the city'
choices.feedback: The angels commanded Lot to flee to the mountains, not to hide.

choices.text: 'Wait a few more days before leaving'
choices.feedback: The angels said 'Flee!' urgently, not to wait.

flee.title: Fire from Heaven
flee.text:
You reach the town of Zoar as the sun rises.
What does the Lord do to Sodom and Gomorrah?

choices.text: The Lord rains down burning sulfur out of the heavens on Sodom and Gomorrah
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:24 — Then the Lord rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah — from the Lord out of the heavens.

choices.text: The Lord sends a great flood over the cities
choices.feedback: Genesis says burning sulfur fell from heaven, not a flood.

choices.text: The Lord spares the cities and lets them stand
choices.feedback: Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed by fire from heaven.

wife_looks.title: She Looked Back
wife_looks.text:
Your wife is behind you.
What happens to her?

choices.text: She looks back and becomes a pillar of salt
choices.feedback: Genesis 19:26 — But Lot's wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

choices.text: She runs safely into Zoar with you
choices.feedback: Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a pillar of salt.

choices.text: She turns into a bird and flies away
choices.feedback: Genesis says she became a pillar of salt.

aftermath.title: The Smoke of the Plain
aftermath.text:
Early in the morning, Abraham gets up and looks down toward Sodom.
He sees dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.
God remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe.
